# Erdős Problem 779

*Reference:* [erdosproblems.com/779](https://www.erdosproblems.com/779)

## Statement
∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 1), let P := ∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), nth Nat.Prime i
    ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ (P + p).Prime ∧ nth Nat.Prime n < p ∧ p < P
